name: Science and Technology
subject: Science and Technology
description: Here you will find the expectations and learning for the five areas of study for Grade 3.

strands.title: STEM Skills and Connections
strands.describer: Throughout Grade 3, in connection with the learning in the Life Systems, Matter and Energy, Structures and Mechanisms, and Earth and Space Systems strands, students will:

overall_expectations.title: STEM Investigation and Communication Skills
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 3, in connection with the learning in the other strands, students will:
overall_expectations.text: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures
overall_expectations.text_html: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures

specific_expectations.text: use a scientific research process and associated skills to conduct investigations
specific_expectations.text_html: use a scientific research process and associated skills to conduct investigations

specific_expectations.text: use a scientific experimentation process and associated skills to conduct investigations
specific_expectations.text_html: use a scientific experimentation process and associated skills to conduct investigations

specific_expectations.text: use an engineering design process and associated skills to design, build, and test devices, models, structures, and/or systems
specific_expectations.text_html: use an engineering design process and associated skills to design, build, and test devices, models, structures, and/or systems

specific_expectations.text: follow established health and safety procedures during science and technology investigations, including wearing appropriate protective equipment and clothing and safely using tools, instruments, and materials
specific_expectations.text_html: follow established health and safety procedures during science and technology investigations, including wearing appropriate protective equipment and clothing and safely using tools, instruments, and materials

specific_expectations.text: communicate their findings, using science and technology vocabulary and formats that are appropriate for specific audiences and purposes
specific_expectations.text_html: communicate their findings, using science and technology vocabulary and formats that are appropriate for specific audiences and purposes

overall_expectations.title: Coding and Emerging Technologies
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 3, in connection with the learning in the other strands, students will:
overall_expectations.text: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life
overall_expectations.text_html: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life

specific_expectations.text: write and execute code in investigations and when modelling concepts, with a focus on testing, debugging, and refining programs
specific_expectations.text_html: write and execute code in investigations and when modelling concepts, with a focus on testing, debugging, and refining programs

specific_expectations.text: identify and describe impacts of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life
specific_expectations.text_html: identify and describe impacts of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life

overall_expectations.title: Applications, Connections, and Contributions
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 3, in connection with the learning in the other strands, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences

specific_expectations.text: describe practical applications of science and technology concepts in their home and community, and how these applications address real-world problems
specific_expectations.text_html: describe practical applications of science and technology concepts in their home and community, and how these applications address real-world problems

specific_expectations.text: investigate how science and technology can be used with other subject areas to address real-world problems
specific_expectations.text_html: investigate how science and technology can be used with other subject areas to address real-world problems

specific_expectations.text: analyse contributions to science and technology from various communities
specific_expectations.text_html: analyse contributions to science and technology from various communities

strands.title: Life Systems
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 3, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 3, students will:
overall_expectations.text: assess ways in which plants are beneficial to society and the environment, and ways in which human activity has an impact on plants and plant habitats
overall_expectations.text_html: assess ways in which plants are beneficial to society and the environment, and ways in which human activity has an impact on plants and plant habitats

specific_expectations.text: assess ways in which plants are important to humans and other living things, taking different perspectives into consideration, and identify ways in which humans can protect native plant species and their habitats
specific_expectations.text_html: assess ways in which plants are important to humans and other living things, taking different perspectives into consideration, and identify ways in which humans can protect native plant species and their habitats

specific_expectations.text: assess ways in which human activities have an impact on plants and plant habitats, and identify personal actions that they could take to minimize harmful effects and enhance positive ones
specific_expectations.text_html: assess ways in which human activities have an impact on plants and plant habitats, and identify personal actions that they could take to minimize harmful effects and enhance positive ones

specific_expectations.text: assess the benefits and limitations of locally grown food
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the benefits and limitations of locally grown food

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 3, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of characteristics and uses of plants and of plants’ responses to the natural environment
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of characteristics and uses of plants and of plants’ responses to the natural environment

specific_expectations.text: describe the basic needs of plants, including the need for air, water, light, heat, nutrients, and space, and identify environmental conditions that may threaten plant survival
specific_expectations.text_html: describe the basic needs of plants, including the need for air, water, light, heat, nutrients, and space, and identify environmental conditions that may threaten plant survival

specific_expectations.text: identify different parts of plants, including the root, stem, flower, stamen, pistil, leaf, seed, cone, and fruit, and describe how each part contributes to plants’ survival within their environment
specific_expectations.text_html: identify different parts of plants, including the root, stem, flower, stamen, pistil, leaf, seed, cone, and fruit, and describe how each part contributes to plants’ survival within their environment

specific_expectations.text: describe changes that different plants undergo in their life cycles
specific_expectations.text_html: describe changes that different plants undergo in their life cycles

specific_expectations.text: describe ways in which a variety of plants adapt and/or react to their environment and to changes in their environment
specific_expectations.text_html: describe ways in which a variety of plants adapt and/or react to their environment and to changes in their environment

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding that most plants get energy directly from the Sun through the process of photosynthesis, which involves the absorption of carbon dioxide and the release of oxygen
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding that most plants get energy directly from the Sun through the process of photosynthesis, which involves the absorption of carbon dioxide and the release of oxygen

specific_expectations.text: describe ways in which people, including Indigenous peoples, from various cultures around the world use plants for food, shelter, medicine, and clothing
specific_expectations.text_html: describe ways in which people, including Indigenous peoples, from various cultures around the world use plants for food, shelter, medicine, and clothing

specific_expectations.text: describe various plants used for food, including those grown by First Nations, Métis, and Inuit, and identify local settings where these plants are grown or found
specific_expectations.text_html: describe various plants used for food, including those grown by First Nations, Métis, and Inuit, and identify local settings where these plants are grown or found

specific_expectations.text: describe ways in which plants and animals, including humans, depend on each other
specific_expectations.text_html: describe ways in which plants and animals, including humans, depend on each other

strands.title: Matter and Energy
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 3, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 3, students will:
overall_expectations.text: assess the impacts of various forces on society and the environment
overall_expectations.text_html: assess the impacts of various forces on society and the environment

specific_expectations.text: assess the effects of the action of forces from natural phenomena on natural and built environments, and identify ways in which human activities can reduce or enhance these effects
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the effects of the action of forces from natural phenomena on natural and built environments, and identify ways in which human activities can reduce or enhance these effects

specific_expectations.text: assess harmful effects of forces that may result from various human activities, and describe how health and safety devices can minimize these effects
specific_expectations.text_html: assess harmful effects of forces that may result from various human activities, and describe how health and safety devices can minimize these effects

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 3, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of how forces cause motion and changes in motion
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of how forces cause motion and changes in motion

specific_expectations.text: describe different types of contact forces and non-contact forces
specific_expectations.text_html: describe different types of contact forces and non-contact forces

specific_expectations.text: describe different ways a force can be exerted on an object
specific_expectations.text_html: describe different ways a force can be exerted on an object

specific_expectations.text: describe how different forces applied to an object, including forces of varying magnitude, can cause the object to start, stop, or change its direction, speed, or shape
specific_expectations.text_html: describe how different forces applied to an object, including forces of varying magnitude, can cause the object to start, stop, or change its direction, speed, or shape

specific_expectations.text: identify ways in which forces are used in their daily lives
specific_expectations.text_html: identify ways in which forces are used in their daily lives

strands.title: Structures and Mechanisms
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 3, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 3, students will:
overall_expectations.text: assess the importance of form, function, strength, and stability in structures to society and the environment
overall_expectations.text_html: assess the importance of form, function, strength, and stability in structures to society and the environment

specific_expectations.text: assess effects on society and the environment of strong and stable structures
specific_expectations.text_html: assess effects on society and the environment of strong and stable structures

specific_expectations.text: assess the environmental impact of structures built by various animals, including structures built by humans
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the environmental impact of structures built by various animals, including structures built by humans

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 3, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the concepts of strength and stability as they relate to structures with various forms and functions, and of the factors that affect structures’ strength and stability
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the concepts of strength and stability as they relate to structures with various forms and functions, and of the factors that affect structures’ strength and stability

specific_expectations.text: describe a structure as a supporting framework that holds a load and has a definite size, shape, and function, and identify structures in the natural environment and in the built environment
specific_expectations.text_html: describe a structure as a supporting framework that holds a load and has a definite size, shape, and function, and identify structures in the natural environment and in the built environment

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the relationship between form and function for various structures
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the relationship between form and function for various structures

specific_expectations.text: identify the strength of a structure as its ability to support a load and describe ways to increase the strength of structures, including ways to increase the strength of different materials used to build them
specific_expectations.text_html: identify the strength of a structure as its ability to support a load and describe ways to increase the strength of structures, including ways to increase the strength of different materials used to build them

specific_expectations.text: describe the stability of a structure as its ability to keep its shape, maintain balance, float, and/or stay fixed in one spot when a force is applied to the structure, and describe ways to improve a structure’s stability
specific_expectations.text_html: describe the stability of a structure as its ability to keep its shape, maintain balance, float, and/or stay fixed in one spot when a force is applied to the structure, and describe ways to improve a structure’s stability

specific_expectations.text: identify properties of materials that need to be considered when building structures
specific_expectations.text_html: identify properties of materials that need to be considered when building structures

specific_expectations.text: describe ways in which different forces can affect the shape, balance, or position of structures
specific_expectations.text_html: describe ways in which different forces can affect the shape, balance, or position of structures

specific_expectations.text: explain the role of struts and ties in structures under load
specific_expectations.text_html: explain the role of struts and ties in structures under load

strands.title: Earth and Space Systems
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 3, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 3, students will:
overall_expectations.text: assess the importance of soils for society and the environment, and the impact of human activity on soils
overall_expectations.text_html: assess the importance of soils for society and the environment, and the impact of human activity on soils

specific_expectations.text: assess the importance of soils for society and the environment
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the importance of soils for society and the environment

specific_expectations.text: assess the impact of human activity on soils, and describe ways in which humans can improve the quality of soils and/or lessen or prevent harmful effects on soils
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the impact of human activity on soils, and describe ways in which humans can improve the quality of soils and/or lessen or prevent harmful effects on soils

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 3, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the composition of soils, of different types of soils, and of processes and practices that can affect the health of soil
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the composition of soils, of different types of soils, and of processes and practices that can affect the health of soil

specific_expectations.text: identify the living and non-living components of soil, and describe the characteristics of healthy soil
specific_expectations.text_html: identify the living and non-living components of soil, and describe the characteristics of healthy soil

specific_expectations.text: identify different substances that are commonly added to, or absorbed by, the soil, and describe their effects on soil health
specific_expectations.text_html: identify different substances that are commonly added to, or absorbed by, the soil, and describe their effects on soil health

specific_expectations.text: examine different types of soils found in Ontario, and describe how different soils are suited to growing different types of food, including crops
specific_expectations.text_html: examine different types of soils found in Ontario, and describe how different soils are suited to growing different types of food, including crops

specific_expectations.text: explain the process of erosion, including its causes and its impact on soils
specific_expectations.text_html: explain the process of erosion, including its causes and its impact on soils

specific_expectations.text: identify various strategies used to maintain and improve soil health in Ontario
specific_expectations.text_html: identify various strategies used to maintain and improve soil health in Ontario

specific_expectations.text: describe the process of composting, and explain some benefits of composting
specific_expectations.text_html: describe the process of composting, and explain some benefits of composting
